cards.title: The Tiger Returns to Kazakhstan in First-in-the-World Rewilding Project a Decade in the Making
cards.caption:
The Tiger Returns to Kazakhstan in First-in-the-World Rewilding Project a Decade in the Making ☀️

Kazakhstan has taken a massive step towards its long-held goal of re-establishing the tiger in the country by releasing a female Amur tiger into the Ile-Balkhash Nature Reserve.
